function: system (p. 5): learned MPDQN sets ISAC sensing/communication time split jointly with VDT placement (p. 9), over a single-antenna link with scalar channel gain and no RIS.
notes: Exclude for system. The PDF matches the DOI: title and 'Digital Object Identifier 10.1109/JIOT.2025.3535767' on p. 1. Learning is present: a multi-agent PDQN, p. 9: 'Each agent selects its action from the action space A, which includes the communication and sensing times, and the VDT placement strategy for the vehicle.' VDT placement is an edge-computing decision, but the sensing/communication time split of the ISAC frame (p. 5, Fig. 2; C1 sensing MI and C2 uplink rate constraints, p. 8) is an ISAC resource of area 5 learned jointly with it, so above_phy and function do not apply. System applies: single-antenna link with no RIS, p. 5, eq. (7), uplink SINR P_n(h_n,v)^2/(sigma^2 + interference), 'where hn,v represents the channel gain between vehicle n and the base station' (scalar); Tables I (p. 4) and II (p. 11) list no antennas, beamforming or RIS, which appear only in related work and references (pp. 2, 14). If the time split is read as scheduling, above_phy (p. 9) applies instead; excluded either way.
